verdicts.label: Apply and hold for the long term
verdicts.track_record: A weak predictor of 1-year returns, about a coin flip: past IPOs with this verdict beat the Nifty 50 over 1 year 53% of the time (tested on 51 IPOs from 2024–25). Use it to understand the business, not to pick winners.

exits.title: Your holding plan
steps: You'd be holding for the business, not the first day's price. Look again on the dates below, and sell if a reason you bought stops being true.

reviews.why: The first results after listing: check sales and profit are still growing.
Half a year on: compare the business with what the RHP promised.
One year on: did it beat simply buying the Nifty 50?

breakers: Sales stop growing, or fall, in two results in a row.
The share price runs so far that its P/E is well above its peers'.
The business stops doing what the IPO money was raised for.
The auditor resigns, or adds remarks to the accounts.

disclaimer: A learning aid worked out by fixed rules, not advice. Only apply with money you won't need soon, and decide for yourself.
